title: Combined-Balance Interest Banding Across Pocketwire Savings Vaults
content:
The interest bands of the Pocketwire Savings Vault are applied to a customer's vaults together, never vault by vault.

## Rule

The base APY applies to the customer's combined vault balance up to the tier's balance cap, and the overflow APY applies to the combined balance above it. The split of the combined balance between the two bands is allocated to each vault in proportion to its end-of-day balance.

The **combined vault balance** is the total of the balances of the customer's vaults that are not closed.

## Condition, judgement, result

- **Input:** the end-of-day balance of each of the customer's vaults that are not closed, and the tier's balance cap.
- **Judgement:** add the balances to obtain the combined balance; the part up to the cap is the base band and the part above the cap is the overflow band.
- **Result:** each vault takes a share of each band equal to its end-of-day balance as a proportion of the combined balance; its base-band share earns the base APY and its overflow share earns the overflow APY.

A customer with a single vault that is not closed has a combined balance equal to that vault's balance, and the whole split falls to that vault.

## Worked allocation (hypothetical figures)

A customer's tier has a balance cap of $10000.00 (hypothetical). At the end of a day Vault A holds $9000.00, Vault B holds $3000.00 and Vault C is closed.

- Combined balance: $9000.00 plus $3000.00, that is $12000.00; Vault C is not counted.
- Base band: $10000.00. Overflow band: $2000.00.
- Vault A holds three quarters of the combined balance, so it takes $7500.00 of the base band and $1500.00 of the overflow band.
- Vault B holds one quarter, so it takes $2500.00 of the base band and $500.00 of the overflow band.

| Vault | End-of-day balance | Share of combined balance | Base-band share | Overflow share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | $9000.00 | three quarters | $7500.00 | $1500.00 |
| B | $3000.00 | one quarter | $2500.00 | $500.00 |
| C (closed) | not counted | none | none | none |
